1. Purpose and scope
This document supplies the domain knowledge an email-classification agent needs. The agent reviews email content
and available metadata, then assigns a category and priority. It is designed for inbox triage—not for making irreversible
decisions or replacing the user.
Expected outcomes
• Detect likely unsolicited, deceptive, malicious, or irrelevant messages and label them as Spam.
• Identify messages that deserve the user's attention and label them Important.
• Keep ordinary correspondence in Normal so the inbox remains useful.
• Send uncertain or high-risk messages to Needs Review rather than guessing.
• Provide a short explanation and confidence score for every classification.
